question: 20261030-1250-research-data-apis-35cd-u04-q05: should https-download be added to the interface vocabulary (interface[] in the dossier schema)? Recommended: yes, https-download for files fetched with a plain HTTP(S) GET from a fixed path or a listing file.
why: Seven records use rest, the nearest term, for plain HTTPS file downloads and name the true access in interface_detail: data-apis/gdelt (lastupdate.txt and masterfilelist.txt list the 15-minute zips), data-apis/meteostat (granularity/year parquet files), data-apis/ip-location-db, data-apis/ip2location-lite, data-apis/maxmind-geolite, debrid/project-gutenberg and debrid/standard-ebooks. OpenWeather's regularly updated bulk snapshots (bulk.openweathermap.org/snapshot with the appid key, Professional plan and up) are the same shape but sit outside the Free plan, so data-apis/openweather keeps rest; its static sample directory answers with no key. With the term added, data-apis/gdelt takes rest and https-download.
